# Ndubuisi Marvellous

> Social media strategy, growth, and community lead for fintech, Web3, and tech brands entering or scaling across Africa. 5+ years of experience, 40M+ organic views, 150K+ followers grown, 20K+ users from ambassador programs.

Ndubuisi Marvellous (thesocialduke) drives social media strategy, community growth, and content for crypto, fintech, SaaS, and emerging tech brands, with a focus on African markets. Past and current work includes Bitget, Binance, and Coinbase (Base).

## Key pages

- [Home](https://ndubuisimarvellous.com/): overview, background, and stats.
- [Services](https://ndubuisimarvellous.com/services): social media strategy & growth, B2B/B2C community building & management, content creation, creator/KOL & ambassador partnerships, event planning & experiential marketing.
- [Bitget case study](https://ndubuisimarvellous.com/bitget): led social media and community for Bitget across Africa: 40M+ organic views, 150K+ new followers, a 20K-user ambassador program, and Bitget Wallet became Nigeria's #1 downloaded crypto app after OKX exited the market.
- [Base (Coinbase) case study](https://ndubuisimarvellous.com/base-southern-africa): coached Base's Southern Africa ambassador and creator network into a consistent source of sharper, on-brand video content, including AI-directed campaign films.
- [Binance case study](https://ndubuisimarvellous.com/binance-street-interviews): short-form street-interview videos for Binance Africa that explained crypto in plain language, made for Instagram and TikTok.
- [Contact](https://ndubuisimarvellous.com/contact): email, resume download, social links and an embedded booking calendar. Open to full-time and contract roles, and available to relocate.
